launches.title: CodeAnt AI - Autonomous offensive and defensive security
launches.tagline: Find the breach before the attacker does!
launches.body:
### What we do

CodeAnt AI attacks your systems the way a real adversary would, then it walks back into your code and helps you build the defenses exactly where the attack got through.

Continuous attack. Continuous defense. One self-learning platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101960&key=user_uploads/304615/2d6a6c48-8892-4d33-9e38-a08770079ab0)

\
\
[**Trigger a free pentest**](https://app.codeant.ai/) No engagement fee. Pay only if we find high or critical issues; low and medium issues are free.

### Why us

We've run pentests for 200+ companies. Almost everyone had exposed PII, PHI, payment records, patient files, or critical data leaks.

We've also disclosed 100+ zero-day CVEs, affecting 1.85B+ monthly downloads, including [pac4j-jwt auth bypass at CVSS 10.0 ](https://www.codeant.ai/security-research/pac4j-jwt-authentication-bypass-public-key)and [simple-git RCE at CVSS 9.8](https://www.codeant.ai/security-research/simple-git-remote-code-execution-cve-2026-28292).

### Why now

**90% of modern software is embarrassingly easy to breach.**

Attackers got AI. A human pentester gets 2 weeks and a scope doc. An AI adversary gets unlimited patience and parallelism, and it'll chain a forgotten subdomain to a leaked credential to a misconfigured auth API until the data is out.\
\
Your defenses? Still fighting the last war.

SAST & SCA tools surface 10,000 findings. The 50 that matter are buried. Pentest firms show up once a year. File a PDF and leave. You fly blind the other 363 days.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101960&key=user_uploads/304615/1c942f59-a1c1-418f-827c-7517ec157597)

### How do we close it

CodeAnt lives at every layer where code is written: CLI, IDE, PR, CI/CD. Then it takes what it learned and attacks.

### What you get

* **Blackbox** 500+ exploit agents (BOLA, IDOR, SSRF, auth bypass, etc)
* **Whitebox** AI SAST, SCA, SBOMs, malware, business logics, etc.
* **Graybox** Black-box + white-box fused, the full kill chain.
* **Evidence** SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO compliant reports

Start your [free pentest](https://app.codeant.ai/) here or schedule a [scoping call](https://meet.codeant.ai/meet/codeant-ai/demo)

launches.body:
## **🏆 TL;DR**

Most developer productivity tools show **numbers**, not **impact**.\
They count commits and PRs but don’t explain what was _actually built, fixed, or improved_.

**CodeAnt AI’s [Developer 360](https://www.codeant.ai/developer-360)** **gives you that missing visibility**,

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94457&key=user_uploads/304615/7facde8e-ac94-47ee-bfdb-a479a02585c4)

\
We’re already enterprises and fast-growing startups, such as **Commvault, Sanas, Akasa Air, and Kore AI** to improve developer productivity.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94457&key=user_uploads/304615/4d0e4ff4-d08a-4668-b2e8-793bd7c4c317)

## **❌ The Problem**

Engineering dashboards today are full of **empty stats.**

Current tools show _50 commits_ and _20 pull requests_, but you have no idea if that’s 50 critical bug fixes or just 50 formatting changes.

Leaders can’t tell the difference between busy work and meaningful progress,\
and developers end up feeling like numbers, not contributors.

## **🌟 The Solution - Developer 360**

Developer 360 shows the _real story_ behind your codebase.\
\
CodeAnt AI reviews every pull request, getting the deepest context of your code, from features shipped to bugs fixed or risks introduced. It looks at every commit, pull request, and pipeline run to show what your team is really doing.

You’ll see:

* What features were shipped
* What bugs and security issues were fixed
* Where reviews or builds are slowing things down
* Who’s driving steady, high-quality progress

Everything rolls up into a single, easy-to-understand view of your engineering work.

**AI Developer Summaries** reports that explain what was shipped, fixed, or improved

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94457&key=user_uploads/304615/a3209b2d-cb3d-4e6c-a074-8d8188cac1e2)

**Throughput Comparison** benchmark developers on consistency, efficiency, and merge quality

launches.title: CodeAnt AI: AI Code Reviewer
launches.tagline: Helping engineering teams cut code review time and bugs by over 50%.
launches.body:
### **PROBLEM:**

Code reviews are already painful — slow, repetitive, and easy to miss bugs & security vulnerabilities. With more AI-written code, it's getting worse: bigger PRs, faster cycles, less peer context.

### **Solution:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77911&key=user_uploads/304615/f41a52cf-20a5-4a3d-8b03-94b77e822984)

1. [CodeAnt AI](https://www.codeant.ai/) connects directly to [GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps](https://app.codeant.ai/) in 2 clicks
2. Builds deep Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) of your entire codebase
3. Automatically reviews every PR for:
   * Code quality issues
   * Security vulnerabilities (SAST, IaC, Secrets, SCA, EOL libs, Cloud misconfigs)
   * Best practice violations
4. Flags exact lines and suggests one-click fixes in Pull Request
5. Add custom rules and design best practices
6. Integrates with [VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=codeantai.codeantai) and [JetBrains IDE](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/23405-codeantai)
7. Works fully inside your pull requests

Result? [**Teams cut code review time and bugs by over 50%.**](https://www.codeant.ai/customer-story) _(Attached case studies)_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77911&key=user_uploads/304615/cf12efdd-ad6c-4c96-866a-07732fdc2021)

Track every code change in your repositories for security and quality issues — mapped to each developer — so you can stack-rank engineers, spot gaps, and drive targeted upskilling.

### 💥 **About Us:**

Hello everyone, we are [Amartya](https://linkedin.com/in/amartya-jha) and [Chinmay](https://linkedin.com/in/chinmay-bharti).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77911&key=user_uploads/304615/197c0c2a-1764-4de7-b97b-120c80d3c9e6)

[Amartya Jha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amartya-jha/) scaled the platform & infrastructure at Zeta and ShareChat to handle millions of requests a day. Tired of bugs slipping through manual reviews, he quit to fix it at the root.

[Chinmay Bharti](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chinmay-bharti/) is an IIT Bombay engineer with a master’s in AI and a second-time founder. He built systems at a high-frequency trading firm where even one bug could cost millions.
